blocks.html: On Monday, April 24th, 2017, the Denver City Council voted to allow extended hours for dispensaries in the city. Operating hours were previously 8 a.m. to 7 p.m., but as of May 1st, 2017, stores may stay open until 10 p.m.! It's 8:00 and you forgot to get a few joints for the night? Have no fear, Starbuds' Denver locations have you covered. We're looking forward to serving Denver's night owls!
